name: Job Search - 2. Job Processor (LLM Match + CV)

nodes.name: OpenRouter - Analyze Match
nodes.notes: Uses an HTTP Header Auth credential for 'Authorization: Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>' - create that credential in n8n and select it, key left empty for you to fill in. Model is a free OpenRouter model; swap for any other ':free' model slug from openrouter.ai/models if this one is unavailable/rate-limited.

nodes.name: Generate Tailored CV (PLACEHOLDER)
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER: point this at wherever your Python CV-generation script is served (e.g. a small Flask/FastAPI service, an n8n Execute Command node running a local script, or a webhook). Expected request: {job_title, company, job_description, base_resume_text}. Expected response: {cv_text: string}. Replace the URL and, if needed, add auth headers.

nodes.name: Update Airtable - Matched
nodes.notes: Updates the row created in Workflow 1 with the match verdict, LLM summary/reasoning and generated CV text.

nodes.name: Update Airtable - Not Matched
nodes.notes: No CV is generated for jobs the LLM flags as a poor match - row is just updated with the verdict for your records.
